title: Rotting Oranges
source: DFS and BFS (Week 12): BFS from many starts

tests.name: Two sources meet in the middle
tests.hint: Start the BFS from every rotten orange at once.

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(994)
grids = [[[random.choice([0, 1, 1, 1, 2]) for _ in range(random.randint(1, 6))] for _ in range(random.randint(1, 6))] for _ in range(40)]
grids = [[row[:min(map(len, g))] for row in g] for g in grids]

tests.name: 199 × 199 snake
tests.data:
n = 199
grid = [[1] * n if r % 2 == 0 else [0] * n for r in range(n)]
for r in range(1, n, 2):
    grid[r][n - 1 if r % 4 == 1 else 0] = 1
grid[0][0] = 2
tests.hint: The rot snakes along a 20 000-cell path. Re-scanning the grid every minute is far too slow.
